verdict.rationale: n8n workflows are stored as portable JSON and can be pushed/pulled via Git-based source control (n8n-docs-22), plus a documented REST API (n8n-docs-16) and full self-hosting (n8n-docs-3, n8n-comm-1/16/17) give users real control to extract and leave with their data. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a bulk 'export all data' feature, independent confirmation of complete data portability (credentials, execution history), and clarity on the fair-code (not fully OSS) license implications for openness (n8n-comm-19).
